description: Checks one email address, and optionally the signup's IP address, the way SignupBouncer checks a new signup. Returns the result as "verdict" (allow, challenge or block), a 0-100 score, the reasons with their reason codes, the normalised inbox (Gmail dots and +tags folded) and the IP's network. When the domain looks like a typo of a big mail provider (gmial.com), "suggestion" holds the corrected address. Looks up the domain's mail servers live. Every reason is listed, including ones only paid plans count. Nothing sent is stored.

ip.description: Optional IPv4 or IPv6 address the signup came from.

name: check_email
